title: Transforming the world's largest sovereign wealth fund with AI: NBIM’s journey with Anthropic
description: Discover how Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM), manager of the world's largest sovereign wealth fund valued at ~$1.8 trillion, is pioneering the use of Agentic AI to transform their operations. In this exclusive webinar, NBIM will share their firsthand experience of successfully deploying AI and measuring its impact, alongside technical insights from Anthropic and AWS. Learn directly from NBIM's journey, explore market trends shaping the future of AI in financial services, and see live demonstrations of the technologies driving this transformation.
